purpose: Requests NMR chemical shieldings via the EPR/NMR module, computing the nuclear magnetic shielding tensor with gauge-including atomic orbitals.
typical_use: NMR chemical shift prediction for closed- or open-shell molecules at HF, DFT, CASSCF, MP2 or (D)LPNO-CC levels.

purpose: Requests the EPR g-tensor (second derivative of the energy), which fixes the signal position in an EPR spectrum.
typical_use: EPR g-tensor prediction for radicals/open-shell species at HF/DFT, CASSCF, MP2 or CC levels.

purpose: Writes the unrestricted-corresponding orbitals (UCOs) for an open-shell wavefunction so they can be printed or used downstream.
typical_use: Corresponding-orbital analysis of unpaired electrons and spin-coupling descriptions.

purpose: Turns the writing of UCO orbitals off (the default).
Requests UHF natural orbitals (UNOs) be produced to picture the open-shell wavefunction compactly; equivalent to %scf UHFNO true.
typical_use: Open-shell wavefunction analysis and as natural-orbital starting point for CASSCF or quasi-restricted orbital schemes.

purpose: Turns the writing of UNO orbitals off (the default).
Activates the natural bond orbital (NBO) analysis along with NPA, via the external NBO program.
typical_use: NBO population analysis, localized NBOs/NLMOs and donor-acceptor interactions.

purpose: Deactivates the NBO analysis (and the NPA it implies).
Requests production of a WFN/WFX file suitable for atoms-in-molecules (AIM) analysis of the wavefunction.
typical_use: Bader/AIM partitioning: generate a wavefunction file to run an external AIM program.

purpose: Suppresses the WFN/WFX file intended for AIM analysis.
Activates all population analyses at once.
typical_use: Turns on the whole built-in population analysis set with a single keyword for one self-consistent run.

purpose: Deactivates all population analyses.
Requests CHELPG charges, ESF-fitted to reproduce the electrostatic potential on a regular grid around the molecule.
typical_use: ESP-fitted partial charges for molecular mechanics; usable as an in-calculation keyword or via the standalone orca_chelpg utility.
literature: Breneman, C. M.; Wiberg, K. B. (CHELPG, cited by section 5.1.8)

purpose: Requests CHELPG charges computed on a larger grid than the default CHELPG.
typical_use: Better-converged ESP-fitted charges where the default CHELPG grid is too coarse.

purpose: Performs a density analysis for fragments of the system.
typical_use: Fragment charge and charge-transfer analyses requiring per-fragment electron densities.

purpose: Requests Mulliken and Loewdin population of the frontier molecular orbitals (HOMO and LUMO).
typical_use: Frontier-orbital atomic populations for reactive-site and donor/acceptor analysis.

purpose: Turns off the frontier molecular orbital population analysis.
Requests Hirshfeld charges, an atoms-in-molecules stockholder partitioning of the electron density into atomic contributions.
typical_use: Stockholder-based AIM partial charges, robust to basis set.
literature: Hirshfeld, F. L. (stockholder partitioning, cited by section 5.1.6)

purpose: Turns off the Hirshfeld population analysis.
Requests Loewdin population analysis, which symmetrically orthogonalizes the basis so all overlap integrals vanish.
typical_use: Löwdin atomic charges and Wiberg bond orders (Löwdin-orthogonalized basis).
literature: Löwdin, P.-O.; Wiberg, K. B. (cited by section 5.1.2)

purpose: Turns off the Loewdin population analysis.
Requests Mayer population analysis, giving Mayer atomic charges and bond orders from the spin-density matrix.
typical_use: Mayer bond-order and valence analysis.
literature: Mayer, I. (Mayer bonding analysis, cited by section 5.1.4)

purpose: Turns off the Mayer population analysis.
Requests Minimal Basis Iterative Stockholder (MBIS) charges, an AIM iterative stockholder partitioning using minimal-basis pro-atomic densities.
defaults: MBIS_CHARGETHRESH 1e-6; P_MBIS default off; MBIS_LARGEPRINT false
typical_use: MBIS partial charges; MBIS_LARGEPRINT also prints atomic dipole, quadrupole and octupole moments.
literature: Verstraelen, T. et al. (MBIS, cited by section 5.1.7)

purpose: Turns off the MBIS population analysis.
Requests the Mulliken population analysis, which divides each overlap charge equally between its two atoms.
typical_use: Mulliken atomic charges, orbital charges, bond orders and fragment populations (the default analysis).
literature: Mulliken, R. S. (Mulliken population analysis, cited by section 5.1.1)

purpose: Turns off the Mulliken population analysis.
Requests Natural Population Analysis (NPA) through the NBO interface.
typical_use: NPA charges; skipped silently by ORCA if the NBO program is unavailable.
literature: Weinhold, F.; Landis, C. R. (NPA via NBO, cited by section 5.1.5)

purpose: Deactivates NPA and NBO analyses.
Prints reduced (per-angular-momentum) Loewdin orbital populations for each MO.
typical_use: Per-angular-momentum MO composition in reduced form.

purpose: Deactivates printing of reduced orbital populations per MO.
Requests RESP charges, CHELPG charges with a penalty (restraint) function to avoid over-fitting, using penalty values a and b.
typical_use: Restrained ESP-fitted charges for molecular-mechanics parameterisation of larger molecules.
literature: Bayly, C. I.; Cieplak, P.; Cornell, W. D.; Kollman, P. A. (RESP, cited by section 5.1.9)

purpose: Activates the ORCA_ESD module for excited-state dynamics, computing dynamic excited-state properties (absorption, fluorescence, phosphorescence, IC, ISC, resonance Raman) via a path-integral/Fermi-golden-rule treatment.
typical_use: Rates and spectra of radiative/non-radiative excited-state processes in molecular systems.

purpose: Requests the absorption property within an ESD excited-state dynamics calculation.
typical_use: One-photon absorption spectra and associated rates.

purpose: Selects a non-default excited-state dynamics property within an ESD run. The manual/OPI do not expand the abbreviation; it corresponds to one of the requested dynamic properties of the ORCA_ESD module.
typical_use: Excited-state property request within an ESD run.

purpose: Selects a non-default excited-state dynamics property within an ESD run. The manual/OPI do not expand the abbreviation; it corresponds to one of the requested dynamic properties of the ORCA_ESD module.
typical_use: Excited-state property request within an ESD run.

purpose: Requests an electronic circular dichroism (ECD) property within ESD.
typical_use: Excited-state circular dichroism spectra.

purpose: Requests the fluorescence rate and spectrum within an ESD calculation.
typical_use: Fluorescence spectra and decay rates in excited-state runs.

purpose: Requests an internal-conversion (IC) property, requiring a nonadiabatic coupling, within ESD.
typical_use: Internal-conversion rates between excited states.

purpose: Requests an intersystem-crossing (ISC) property within an ESD calculation.
typical_use: Spin-forbidden intersystem-crossing rates.

purpose: Requests a magnetic circular dichroism (MCD) property within ESD.
typical_use: Excited-state magnetic circular dichroism spectra.

purpose: Requests a phosphorescence property (phosphorescence rate and spectrum) within an ESD calculation.
typical_use: Phosphorescence (triplet-to-singlet) rate/spectra.

purpose: Requests a resonance Raman property within an ESD calculation (same as ESD(RRAMAN)).
typical_use: Resonance Raman spectra in excited-state dynamics runs.

purpose: Requests a resonance Raman property within an ESD calculation (alias of ESD(RR)).
typical_use: Resonance Raman spectra in excited-state dynamics runs.
